SELECT ud.id, ud.user_id, u.username, u.nickname, u.phone, u.email, u.status AS user_status, ud.post, ud.is_main, ud.create_time FROM sys_user_dept ud INNER JOIN sys_user u ON ud.user_id = u.id WHERE ud.dept_id = #{deptId} AND u.deleted = 0
AND (u.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{username}, '%') OR u.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{username}, '%'))
ORDER BY ud.is_main DESC, ud.create_time ASC

SELECT ud.id, ud.user_id, u.username, u.nickname, u.phone, u.email, u.status AS user_status, ud.post, ud.is_main, ud.create_time FROM sys_user_dept ud INNER JOIN sys_user u ON ud.user_id = u.id WHERE ud.dept_id = #{deptId} AND u.deleted = 0 ORDER BY ud.is_main DESC, ud.create_time ASC

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.username, u.nickname, u.phone, u.email, u.status AS user_status FROM sys_user u WHERE u.deleted = 0 AND u.id NOT IN ( SELECT ud.user_id FROM sys_user_dept ud WHERE ud.dept_id = #{deptId} )
AND (u.username LIKE CONCAT('%', CONCAT(#{username}, '%')) OR u.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', CONCAT(#{username}, '%')))
ORDER BY u.username
